entities.name: Arras
entities.description: Anaba spirit crafter (minotaur shaman) from Ulgrotha, a wise and compassionate guide of his clan.

entities.name: Thexar
entities.description: Dying clan member tended by Arras.

entities.name: Neth'arna
entities.description: Shaman responsible for the scarring ritual that went tragically wrong.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: Spell sealing Ulgrotha; fell hundreds of years later.

events.summary: Arras tends the dying Thexar, wiping away blood and offering comfort.
events.quote: He knelt beside Thexar, tenderly wiping away the blood and offering comforting words.

events.summary: Arras sharply reminds Neth'arna that making excuses benefits no one.
events.quote: He sharply reminded Neth’arna that making excuses benefited no one

events.summary: Arras tells stories of past warriors to distract Thexar from his pain.
events.quote: Arras sought to distract Thexar from his pain, using tales of past warriors and battles to offer solace

relations.quote: Arras was an Anaba spirit crafter from Ulgrotha

relations.note: Prepared her to face the consequences of her actions.
relations.quote: preparing Neth’arna to face the consequences of her actions and learn from them
